Frequently asked questions

How long does carpet take to dry?

Usually several hours, depending on the carpet and ventilation. We can schedule evening work so it is dry by morning.

How often should floors be stripped and waxed?

High-traffic commercial floors usually need it once or twice a year, with regular buffing in between.

Can you remove winter salt stains?

Yes. Salt residue is common in Massachusetts and New Hampshire; we neutralize and remove it from carpet and hard floors.
